info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Meetings Meetings Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Meetings Status API provides real-time insights into the status of scheduled meetings within the system. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve detailed information about ongoing, upcoming, or past meetings. Typical users include event coordinators, project managers, and team leads who need to monitor and manage meeting logistics effectively. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their scheduling workflows and ensure optimal use of resources.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of meetings.
get.description: This endpoint provides the latest status information for meetings, allowing users to check on their schedules and participation status.
